source.title: 96% of IT pros use AI now: Their top 7 agentic applications and biggest implementation roadblocks
source.author: Joe McKendrick,

athena.directive: Architect and design the Creative Liberation Engine as a self-sovereign, intuitively intelligent platform that empowers human oversight and accelerates trusted AI-driven decision-making by making AI outputs transparent, explainable, and seamlessly integrated into existing workflows, while automating foundational data work and ensuring robust governance.
athena.rationale: The market is rapidly adopting AI, but faces significant roadblocks: a substantial 'AI tax' due to manual data preparation and output validation, difficulty interpreting AI results, and concerns around data access and governance. The Creative Liberation Engine must address these critical pain points by providing a platform that not only automates agentic applications but also elevates human trust and understanding, ensuring that AI augments, rather than complicates, human decision-making. This aligns with Article I (Sovereignty) by building owned solutions, Article IV (Quality Standards) by delivering complete, integrated capabilities, and Article XX (Zero human wait time) by automating manual burdens.

options.title: The 'Explainable AI Workbench'
options.description: Develop a dedicated, interactive workbench within the Creative Liberation Engine for validating, explaining, and correcting AI agent outputs. This addresses the 'AI tax' of manual validation and the primary barrier of explaining AI outputs to decision-makers.
options.tradeoffs: Architecture: High complexity in developing robust, real-time explainability models and integrating diverse AI agent outputs. Requires advanced logging and traceability. Design: Significant UX research needed to translate complex AI explanations into intuitive, actionable insights for business users. Risk of information overload if not carefully designed.

options.title: Workflow Weaver: Adaptive Agent Orchestration
options.description: Create a dynamic, low-code/no-code agent orchestration layer that allows users to design, deploy, and monitor complex agentic workflows for tasks like communication drafting, scheduling, and process automation. This leverages the top agentic applications identified.
options.tradeoffs: Architecture: Requires a highly flexible and resilient event-driven architecture to manage diverse agents and dynamic workflows. Complex state management and error handling across distributed agents. Design: Needs an intuitive visual workflow builder that can represent complex logic clearly and provide real-time status updates without overwhelming the user.

options.title: Data Alchemist: Self-Service Data Preparation & Governance
options.description: Implement a comprehensive, self-sovereign data platform within the Creative Liberation Engine focused on automated data cleaning, integration, and governance, addressing the significant time spent on foundational data work and the 'data not clean' barrier.
options.tradeoffs: Architecture: Requires robust data profiling, lineage tracking, and schema management capabilities. Deep integration with various data sources (internal/external) via SIGNAL. Design: Must offer clear visualizations of data quality, intuitive tools for defining governance rules, and a 'data health' dashboard to make complex data concepts accessible to non-technical users.

options.title: Insight Navigator: Real-time Decision Support & Predictive Analytics
options.description: Integrate real-time data streaming and processing to enable agents to generate immediate insights and predictive recommendations, addressing the current lack of real-time capabilities in most organizations.
options.tradeoffs: Architecture: High demands on infrastructure for real-time data ingestion, processing, and model inference. Ensuring accuracy and reliability of real-time predictions. Design: Requires dynamic dashboards that can visualize rapidly changing data, predictive trends, and actionable recommendations in a clear, concise manner, potentially using glassmorphism for layered data views.

options.title: Trust Fabric: Secure & Governed Agent Data Access
options.description: Architect a robust, granular access control and auditing system specifically for AI agents, allowing 'unrestricted access' to data while enforcing strict policies and providing transparent human oversight, addressing security concerns and accountability.
options.tradeoffs: Architecture: Extremely high security and compliance requirements, demanding a dedicated security agent (e.g., SENTINEL), immutable audit trails, and sophisticated policy enforcement. Performance overhead of granular access controls. Design: Needs a highly transparent and auditable interface for defining and monitoring agent data access policies, with clear alerts for violations and a visual representation of data flow and access permissions.

options.title: AI Literacy Co-Pilot: Skill Augmentation & Guided Learning
options.description: Embed an 'AI tutor' agent that provides contextual explanations of AI concepts and outputs, guides users through analytical tasks, and helps bridge the 'limited analytical skills' gap among business users.
options.tradeoffs: Architecture: Requires sophisticated natural language understanding and generation capabilities. Integration with KEEPER for knowledge retrieval and an adaptive learning model. Design: A conversational AI interface that acts as an intelligent co-pilot, offering explanations, suggesting analytical paths, and providing interactive tutorials directly within the application. Needs to be non-intrusive and context-aware.
